policy.applies_to: Named target-conformance profiles; pto-v0 remains a deterministic raw-carrier reference and is not a target result fallback.
policy.authority: Every open numeric dimension remains owned by pto-numeric-v1 until an accepted PTO decision delegates the exact variation point.
policy.delegation: Delegation requires a named target profile or visible selector plus exact applicability and a finite or mathematically testable allowed-result contract.
policy.unsupported: Unsupported operation/type/profile tuples reject before effects and do not define numeric results.
policy.missing_rule: Unknown profiles, selectors, formats, tuples, and absent delegated rules reject before effects.
policy.evidence_boundary: Backend and independent executable-model behavior are structural evidence only and never acquire numeric ownership implicitly.
